description: Check a queued sequence enrollment realignment. Call this with the jobId returned by realign_sequence_enrollments after applying with dryRun false. When status is completed, result contains the realignment counts, sample, and any nextCursor needed for another bounded apply call.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

jobId.description: Realignment job ID returned by realign_sequence_enrollments.

sequenceId.description: Sequence ID used when the realignment was queued.

name: get_sequence_enrollment_realignment

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `get_sequence_enrollment_realignment` MCP tool.

appUrls.description: Dashboard URLs for relevant Sequenzy resources.

dryRun.description: Always false for an applied job.

error.description: Safe recovery guidance when the job failed, otherwise null.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

result.description: Completed realignment result, including counts, changes, hasMore, and nextCursor; null until completion.

subscriptionUrl.description: Owner-facing subscription, upgrade, and billing-management URL when available.

url.description: Primary dashboard URL for this result.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
